name: Berea College
tuition_note: 2025-26 published Tuition & Fees ($55,480) from berea.edu/student-financial-aid/cost-of-attendance; private single rate. Berea is tuition-free: every enrolled student pays $0 via the Tuition Promise Scholarship, but $55,480 is the published sticker/scholarship value. Housing (room only) $5,000; separate board/food $4,142 not included in housing_cost.
